udayagiri_gate.label: Udayagiri fort gate in the rain
udayagiri_gate.anchor: The Udayagiri fort near Padmanabhapuram: long granite and laterite curtain walls with low angled bastions enclosing a rocky wooded hill, a deep gateway under a sloping tiled gatehouse roof, a muddy approach road and palms bending in the wind. The lone rider passes through the open gate on a bay mare, horse and man dark with wet.
udayagiri_gate.absent: No tall castle towers, Portuguese or Dutch flags, hilltop stone cell or other riders; no cloak, hat, tricorn or turban on the rider.
udayagiri_gate.time: grey afternoon, rain sweeping in from the west and blurring the hills

ramayyan_room.label: Ramayyan's small room off the war hall
ramayyan_room.anchor: A small whitewashed laterite room with a dressed stone floor: Ramayyan's low wooden seat against the back wall under the one unglazed window with wooden bars, which looks onto a narrow courtyard and a single neem; a clay oil lamp in a niche in the side wall to his right; a low table before him with palm-leaf bundles, and across it one low stool facing him with the door behind it. Keep this floor plan in every view of the room.
ramayyan_room.absent: No chairs, desk, bookshelves, paper, quill, glass lamp, glazed window or European furniture, no extra people, and no legible script on any palm leaf.
ramayyan_room.time: rainy afternoon: grey window light and the warm open-wick glow of the niche lamp

room_courtyard.label: Neem courtyard outside Ramayyan's room
room_courtyard.anchor: The narrow courtyard outside Ramayyan's room: the whitewashed laterite wall under sloping tiled eaves, the room's one barred, unglazed window, a timber doorway in the same range, a single neem tree and wet stone paving. Seen from outside, the lamplit window is the only warm light.
room_courtyard.absent: No glass in the window, no glass lantern, no fountain or statue, and no figures beyond those the panel names.
room_courtyard.time: after the rain, the neem dripping and its leaves gleaming

tiruchirappalli_vision.label: Tiruchirappalli walls in the letter image
tiruchirappalli_vision.anchor: Dusty open ground before Tiruchirappalli: old stone town ramparts with square towers, and behind them the great bare granite rock with a small temple at its summit. Maratha horsemen in white angarkhas and pagdis under saffron swallow-tailed pennants ride close about the chained captive.
tiruchirappalli_vision.absent: No European soldiers or flags, no sea or coconut palms, no readable face on the captive and no blood.

maratha_host_plain.label: Maratha host riding south
maratha_host_plain.anchor: An open dry plain of red earth and pale grass with scattered palmyra, the Maratha host riding south in loose columns under saffron swallow-tailed pennants, long bamboo lances upright. Far ahead lies a green line of coconut palms and a thin strip of sea.
maratha_host_plain.absent: No rust-red turbans or red sashes, no Nagoji among the riders, no guns, European troops or close ships.
maratha_host_plain.time: late gold light, dust hanging behind the riders

carnatic_halt_memory.label: Carnatic halt after a skirmish, years ago
carnatic_halt_memory.anchor: A dusty Carnatic halt after a skirmish: baked red earth, thorn scrub and a few palmyra palms, sweating horses blowing behind the two men. The older sardar stands on the left with his hand clapped on young Nagoji's shoulder.
carnatic_halt_memory.absent: No bodies or blood, no coast, no beards on either man, and no white coat, chain of office, topknot or grey hair on young Nagoji.

north_toll_post.label: Toll post on the northern road
north_toll_post.anchor: A Travancore toll post on the road in from the north: a low tiled shelter on laterite posts, a wooden bar across the muddy road, wet scrub and palms. A trader's pack horse stands with its saddlebags open beside his cloth bales.
north_toll_post.absent: No fort, soldiers in coats, Europeans or principal characters, and no legible script on the ola.
north_toll_post.time: steady rain under a grey sky

deccan_village_vision.label: Deccan village courtyard in the letter's promise
deccan_village_vision.anchor: A Deccan village courtyard on black soil: mud-plastered walls under a low country-tiled roof, a clay hearth under a lean-to, brass pots, and dry fields running to a low basalt ridge.
deccan_village_vision.absent: No Kerala laterite, coconut palms or coast, no Nagoji in the scene, and no inset.
deccan_village_vision.time: warm late-afternoon light, soft-edged like memory

taken_fort_vision.label: Travancore star fort taken, in vision
taken_fort_vision.anchor: An imagined Travancore coastal star fort of laterite with angled bastions, saffron swallow-tailed Maratha pennants on them and its cannon swung round to point inland over palm-shaded villages, while Maratha horse pour past it down from the hills to the north. Far offshore, small European ships with men at the rails look on.
taken_fort_vision.absent: No silver-conch Travancore standard still flying, no bodies or blood, no British red coats; the ships stay small and distant.

estate_fire_vision.label: Padmini's estate burning, in vision
estate_fire_vision.anchor: Padmini's Travancore estate at night: the tiled house, pepper vines climbing their support trees and the great jackfruit tree, all lit by fire. Maratha riders are only black silhouettes against the flames.
estate_fire_vision.absent: No bodies or blood, no Padmini or Nagoji, and no Kollamkara raiders or green banner.

velinadu_house.label: Velinadu house
velinadu_house.anchor: Revathi's Velinadu house: laterite walls under sloping tiled roofs, a verandah of carved wooden pillars, wooden-barred windows, woven floor mats and brass open-wick lamps, palms beyond the compound wall. Revathi is alone in the panel.
velinadu_house.absent: No chairs, desks, glass lamps or European objects, no Nagoji, and no legible script on any leaf.

bastion_vision.label: New bastion on a Travancore wall, withheld
bastion_vision.anchor: A newly built angled star bastion on a Travancore laterite wall with a battery of iron guns on its platform, and masons with baskets and lime mortar patching a section of wall below.
bastion_vision.absent: No figures from the room, no European flags, and no lettering or marks on the guns.
bastion_vision.time: daylight, half swallowed by lamp shadow

coastal_verandah_vision.label: Coastal house verandah, written and withheld
coastal_verandah_vision.anchor: The tiled verandah of a Nair coastal house on a laterite plinth with timber pillars, palms and sea glare beyond, a brass betel box on the mat between the two men seated as equals. The closed tribute chests sit in the shadowed half.
coastal_verandah_vision.absent: No chairs or European furniture; the Maratha sardar wears a white angarkha and pagdi, never a rust-red turban or red sash; no principal characters.
coastal_verandah_vision.time: split between bright daylight and deep lamp shadow

goa_waterfront.label: Goa waterfront at night
goa_waterfront.anchor: The Goa waterfront on the Mandovi river at night: whitewashed warehouse walls with round stone arches and tiled roofs along a stone quay, Portuguese ships and smaller country craft riding at anchor on the dark water.
goa_waterfront.absent: No British red coats or Dutch blue coats; the trader is not Ibrahim and has no beard, scar, turban, short coat or vest.
goa_waterfront.time: night, desaturated, a single glass lantern

goa_chamber.label: Goa interrogation chamber from chapter 1
goa_chamber.anchor: The vaulted wet-stone interrogation chamber of the Goa dungeon from chapter 1, seen from high in the vault: the stool, the brazier, an iron ring in the ceiling with a rope hanging from it, and small figures below.
goa_chamber.absent: No noose, no blood or gore, no British red coats or Dutch blue coats, and no cassock on the gaoler.

fort_parade_ground.label: Fort parade ground and drill lines
fort_parade_ground.anchor: The fort parade ground from chapter 24: packed red earth inside angled laterite star-fort walls, the stables across the yard, a field gun on its carriage and drill lines of men in white Travancore coats.
fort_parade_ground.absent: No blue VOC coats or British red coats, no hats on the drilling men, and no Portuguese musketeers or Goa buildings.

chapel_vision.label: Udayagiri chapel, imagined
chapel_vision.anchor: A small chapel of local stone in a quiet corner of the Udayagiri fort: a simple wooden cross, a plain altar with one brass oil lamp, and a stone floor where the two men kneel side by side before it.
chapel_vision.absent: No stained glass, gilded altarpiece, statues or Hindu temple elements, no stole or chasuble, and no temple priest.
chapel_vision.time: soft lamplight in an imagined evening

udayagiri_rampart.label: Udayagiri wall walk at evening
udayagiri_rampart.anchor: The wall walk of the Udayagiri fort: dry granite and laterite parapet stones and angled bastions, the green country falling away below and wooded hills to the north. Nagoji stands alone, small against the sky, looking north.
udayagiri_rampart.absent: No other figures on the wall, no lettered flags and no glass lantern.
udayagiri_rampart.time: evening weeks after the rain, the sky clearing and a new bank of cloud building over the northern hills

page-02-panel-02.bleed: A painted letter image, cool and dusty with soft edges, set apart from the lamplit room; no one from the room appears in it.

page-02-panel-03.bleed: The same soft-edged painted letter image as the panel before, a world behind the words rather than a memory.

page-02-panel-04.lettering_space: Keep the bare lamplit laterite wall in the upper half of the frame clear for the three letter captions.

page-02-panel-05.bleed: Flashback in warm, sun-bleached colour, years before the story: Nagoji in his early twenties, lean, with no grey at all, in a plain cotton angarkha and a dusty saffron turban instead of his present uniform.

page-03-panel-04.bleed: A soft-edged cutaway like the letter images, not a view through the window; neither speaker appears in it.
page-03-panel-04.lettering_space: Leave quiet wet sky above the shelter for two long off-panel speeches, their tails running off the panel edge.

page-03-panel-05.time: driving storm rain, water sheeting off the eaves, the window a small square of lamplight
page-03-panel-05.lettering_space: Keep the rain-streaked wall and eaves around the lit window low in detail for three speeches whose tails point to the window.

page-04-panel-01.bleed: Warm, soft-edged memory light, a promise imagined from the letter rather than a present scene; no inset.

page-04-panel-02.bleed: The same soft edges turned hard and cold: an imagined future, not a memory.

page-04-panel-03.bleed: Imagined in the same hard, cold vision style, sharing its tier with the Velinadu panel beside it.

page-04-panel-04.time: dusk, smoke rising on the far horizon
page-04-panel-04.bleed: Imagined in the same vision style as the burning estate beside it; Revathi alone at the window.

page-05-panel-05.bleed: Four fragments flow out of the lamplight around the writing Nagoji like smoke, each bleeding into the next: the woman's hands and Keshavrao's drowning hand show no faces, and only Padmini, her hair still fully black, shows a face.

page-06-panel-01.bleed: Inset in the upper corner, sun-hard against the lamplit room: Colachel beach, a Dutch square in blue coats and black tricorns pressed against the waterline while Travancore Nair infantry and horse close from both flanks, under plain flags with no lettering or monograms.

page-06-panel-02.bleed: Drawn half in lamp shadow, as if a hand had passed across it: a withheld image, not a place in the room.

page-06-panel-03.bleed: Split by light like the bastion panel before it: the verandah meeting in the lit half, the closed tribute chests pushed back into the shadowed half.

page-08-panel-02.time: the niche lamp outshone by the flare of the burning leaves, black smoke lifting

page-09-panel-02.lettering_space: Leave quiet, low-detail table surface above the hand and leaf for the leaf caption box; the leaf itself carries only small scored marks.

page-10-panel-02.bleed: Desaturated flashback some eleven years earlier: Duarte younger, his hair still dark, nothing of the present room.

page-11-panel-01.bleed: Desaturated flashback reusing the approved chapter 1 frame; if redrawn, Nagoji is the young captive in torn ochre rags with no grey and no uniform, and Duarte is younger with dark hair.

page-11-panel-02.bleed: Soft-edged like the other voice-over images: a present-day cutaway, not a view through the window.
page-11-panel-02.lettering_space: Leave open bright sky above the drill lines for three off-panel speeches.

page-12-panel-02.bleed: Flashback to the chapter 24 meeting, softened at the edges: Duarte older and grey in his black cassock, Nagoji in his white coat.

page-12-panel-05.time: rain easing, the neem dripping, lamplight in the window

page-13-panel-01.bleed: Soft-edged flashback to the same chapter 24 meeting, with Nagoji seen from behind at the edge of the frame.

page-13-panel-05.bleed: Imagined and soft-edged, a scene still to come rather than a memory; no one from the room appears in it.

character_notes.nagoji: Thick curled moustache; clean-shaven chin and jaw, smooth skin, no beard or facial scar, and a tiny flush gold ear stud on the lobe with nothing hanging from it. In the present he is bare-headed with a Kerala topknot and the first grey at the temples, in the white coat, red waistcoat and silver chain, never the turban or sash on his sheet; only flashbacks to his youth show him with no grey.
character_notes.ramayyan: Thin, sharp fine features and receding hair, bare-headed, plain unbordered white cloth, no jewellery, forehead marks or sacred thread; never the temple priest's face.
character_notes.padmini: In her fifties, thick black hair coiled at the nape with grey now threading through it, simple gold, the old Kerala drape with no stitched blouse and a long walking stick; in the memory fragment of the writing scene her hair is still fully black.
character_notes.revathi: A little younger than Nagoji: deep indigo sari with gold, a tali, grey threading her hair, jasmine in her braid, flat-coin necklace and a sandalwood line at the hairline as her only forehead mark.
character_notes.duarte: Thin and gaunt with a scholar's stoop, lined face, grey tired eyes and ink-stained fingers, plain black cassock with a plain standing collar and a small cross on a thin chain, never a white collar tab. Grey-haired in the present and the parade-ground flashbacks, darker-haired in the older flashbacks; never the temple priest's face.
character_notes.joao: Broad, heavy and ruddy, brown leather jerkin over a cream shirt, wide belt and iron key ring; not a priest, no cassock or collar.
character_notes.eustachius: Tall and clean-shaven with pale hair and a long nose, in his white Travancore coat; never a blue coat.
character_notes.kayal: Bay mare: ochre red-brown coat with black mane, tail and lower legs and no white markings, here darkened by rain; never a grey or black horse.
character_notes.chanda_sahib: Heavy bearded build, white Mughal jama and high cream turban, iron at his wrists; seen only at a distance among his captors, never a readable face, and no red.
character_notes.nagoji_father: White-haired, bent and thick-knuckled, coarse dhoti, white pheta and black wool kambal; a plain village elder, not a noble.
character_notes.nagoji_mother: Hands only: green glass bangles and turmeric-stained fingers at the edge of a nine-yard sari worn kashta-style; no face.
character_notes.keshavrao: Hand only: a thin young hand and wrist in prisoner rags slipping from a rope in black storm water; no face.
